title: Astrid and the Ghost
author: Sebastian Thornbury
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
